api.signature: route_failed_attempt(repo, request, *, policy) -> dict; additive private helpers permitted; no new CLI
api.execution: Read-only local Git/files/JSON checks, no command execution beyond existing Git inspection; no retry, state write, reservation, process launch, cleanup or network. Reuse AssuranceError, finite exact JSON/canonical/SHA, regular_file, typed immutable _receipt_artifact/_lane_file, _receipt_candidate, _receipt_contract, existing schema validators and verify_record_update. Do not modify existing helpers/engines.
api.request: Exact keys operation_id,contract_id,feature_id,step_key,attempt,stage,cause. IDs/stage nonempty strings; contract_id==feature_id; attempt exact int1..3 (never bool); cause exactly infrastructure or semantic. No request-selected authority/capture, budget, producer, success, probe or counter overrides.
api.policy: Exact keys repository,coordination_ref,authority_ref. Repository equals actual origin. Refs use existing exact path/sha256/revision immutable type, artifact-containing commit, regular files and current bytes/modes for current coordination. Caller outside API must independently select this trusted policy, never derive it from the request.
api.authority: Immutable authority_ref JSON exact keys schema_version,role,repository,approved,contract_ref,coordination_ref,candidate,producer,capture_ref,evidence_ref plus all request keys. Version exact int1, role Orchestrator, approved exactTrue, repository matches policy, request values match exactly. Existing approved contract with both pre-code approvals matches feature. Existing assessed candidate and producer shapes validated; candidate actual repository/inputs/environment/exercised revision checked using existing validators. Authority coordination_ref anchors the allocated attempt before handoff; current coordination_ref is independently selected live snapshot.
api.continuity: Validate anchor/current run_state schemas, selected repository/current_feature/active_contract_id(if present)/in_progress and same current_phase. Require history lists in both. execution_lanes must be absent in both, or present in both as canonically identical lists; add/remove/reorder/content transitions reject in this read-only routing assessment. Compare the original full anchor/current records using unchanged verify_record_update with /history only, adding /updated_at only when that existing anchor field is a string and current retains a string; if absent in anchor it must remain absent. History remains exact prefix; no list-valued owned pointer or absent owned pointer is passed. All counters, budget, operator and other values unchanged. Selected step counter has exact integer attempts==request.attempt and limit==3 in both snapshots. Authority remains stable across process/agent/session/generation/stage boundaries; a renamed stage/operation/step/contract cannot escape its pinned identity. New independent steps require separately selected Root authority; API cannot establish that authority itself.
api.capture: capture_ref is actual wrapper capture JSON with existing receipt-capture exact keys schema_version,argv,cwd,revision,candidate_sha256,environment,producer,executed,outcome,exit_code,stdout,stderr. Version exact int1; nonempty argv strings/cwd; executed exactTrue; exit_code exact nonzero int; outcome exactly infrastructure-failed or semantic-failed matching authority.cause. Candidate digest/environment/producer match authority; revision is actual committed candidate or allowed protected-input descendant. Output refs verify committed and current bytes/modes, decode UTF8; never guess stdout markers or infer cause from substrings. Existing output is inspected as evidence without executing it.
api.evidence_profile: evidence_ref selects independently classified JSON exact keys schema_version,kind,reason,capture_ref,verdict_ref. Version exact int1; kind equals authority.cause; reason bounded nonempty string1..400; capture_ref exactly matches authority capture_ref. Infrastructure verdict_ref must be null; semantic verdict_ref must be immutable typed reference to schema-valid contract_review or qa_verdict, with final_verdict.approved false OR at least one nonempty issues/missing_acceptance_coverage/unsupported_claims array. Explicitly reject a passing semantic verdict and capture/profile/cause mismatch. The selected classification attestation binds actual failed capture; it is not an automatically inferred universal failure taxonomy.
api.result: Return exactly operation_id,contract_id,feature_id,step_key,attempt,stage,cause,outcome,route,attempts_used,limit,remaining,capture_ref. Preserve bound identity/cause/ref; outcome always failed, attempts_used=attempt, limit=3, remaining=3-attempt. For attempts1/2 route infrastructure-diagnosis or semantic-repair by cause; for attempt3 route halt for either cause. This proposes diagnostic destination, never allocates a next attempt or changes the existing strategy ladder/halt duties. Returned values do not alias inputs.
api.errors_and_boundary: Invalid/missing/stale/unknown/ambiguous/nonfinite/cyclic/unsafe/mismatched data, bool counts, reset/limit override, zero exit or unrun/pending/running/success/probe evidence raises AssuranceError with nonempty bounded diagnostic, no success result/input/files/state mutation. Integrity/hash/producer labels and schema validity do not authenticate classification, human consent or factual truth; independent Root selection and evidence review remain required. Current Root legacy-binding migration remains unapplied; aligned fixture proof is not actual Root adoption. A nested expected nonzero negative can yield a successful outer acceptance command; a failed outer wrapper remains failed and cannot be relabeled successful or a probe.

acceptance_ownership.inventory: Exactly four ordered selectors infrastructure-failed,semantic-failed,reject-cause-relabel,counter-continuity, default46. Independent author may add bounded subcases only. Fixture repositories use actual committed refs/current schemas and independently pinned authority/profiles/captures; fixture producer/authorization is explicitly synthetic. Preserve actual failed runs; Git/setup/missing API failures never count as intended semantic red.
acceptance_ownership.gates: Both independent pre-code gates approve identical proposal before Root approval. Independent author freezes concrete API/test bytes and obligations, distinct provisional reviewer approves before Source. Initial missing API is setup. Generator commits initial Source before development behavior runs; genuine intended behavioral-red before repair, actual per-case positive/private intended-semantic-negative/restored controls and distinct final executable review/seal precede Mode B. Do not weaken contract/tests or treat absent API/setup as red; bundle changes require renewed independent review.
acceptance_ownership.preservation: Compare actual inherited Source function/class/CLI ASTs and test definitions/inventories to immutable preimplementation objects; only additive test main dispatch permitted. Require inputs/current files/counters/history/prior proof and outside sentinels byte/mode preserved. Include typed bool/string/null, cycle/nonfinite, wrong/missing/stale refs, changed output/candidate/producer/shape, success/zero/unrun and mismatched classification negatives within four cases.

verification.acceptance_test: AT1 infrastructure-failed: pinned actual nonzero infrastructure capture yields failed diagnosis route with unchanged counter1/2;3 yields halt; invalid/success/unrun/stale proof rejects with restored positive.

AT2 semantic-failed: pinned nonzero wrapper plus independently selected rejecting semantic verdict yields failed repair route; passing/missing/mismatched verdict rejects; nested expected negative does not convert failed outer wrapper to success.

AT3 reject-cause-relabel: attempt to relabel pinned infrastructure/semantic failure, make success/probe, replace evidence/capture/producer or select request authority rejects; original classification restores exactly.

AT4 counter-continuity: same identity and authoritative counters1/2/3 survive handoff/history append with lanes absent in both or identical lists in both; lane add/remove/reorder/content change and process/agent/generation/stage relabel, counter reset/change, extra budget, fourth attempt or rewritten prior history rejects; all inputs/state/proof unchanged.
